caption: The video captures a glowing cyan Buddha head statue centered below, framed by an arch-shaped opening in an iridescent soap-film dome against black. The dome fills the upper frame with shifting rainbow interference colors, a bright blue-green arc along its top, magenta and purple bands around the arch, and horizontal green-purple stripes across the lower film. The striped bands slowly drift and change spacing, while magenta blotches near the top deform and shift position gradually. The thin film's interference pattern shifts slowly, while the dome's overall outline appears broadly consistent. A dark silhouette remains on the left side of the film, and a dark vertical shape stays near the right edge. The Buddha head stays centered and largely unchanged in position, size, and glow.
relations: Film thickness gradients drive slow drift and spacing changes in the green-purple horizontal stripes.
Flowing film causes magenta blotches near the top to deform and shift position gradually.
The dome outline and centered Buddha head remain stable while interference colors continuously shift.
Dark silhouette on left and vertical shape on right persist as the iridescent pattern evolves.
